items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: I was a trombone player on Al Wagner's show. ... I was a trombone player on Al Wagner's show, Al Wagner's carnival.

ctx.x: So it touched that way. And with all of these carnival shows now you play drums?
I play drums on most of all of them, except the Cavalcade carnival. The Cavalcade carnival show, that's Al Wagner's show.
I don't know one from the other.
